contract: SKL-3 X (monster fights only for every status; XEnabled stays off until the 10/20 check, X at Lv25): Roar (r12 x2, Taunt r16 4 s via MonsterService.Taunt, my Guard 40% 6 s, Halo friends r16 20%, Horns +5 MP a monster hit, the anvil look for the blacksmith); Field (a circle r12 at the aimed monster within 35 or 10 ahead, a tick every 1 s for 5 s at x1.5 with one cast id, Slow x0.5 for tick + 0.5 s, Halo friends inside 20% for tick + 0.1 s, Horns 2 MP a monster a tick; one field a player; it ends on a KO / zone / class / faction change / kaiju / new character (Fx SkillEnd { UserId, Slot, Why }), quietly on leaving; never players; Fields off = one x7.5 burst with a 3 s slow); Hop (back HopReach of 10, under 3 'CantHop', a sack or kaiju 'TooHeavy', both before MP; ZoneService.AllowMove(hop + 2, 1 s); Fx Hop { To, T } to the caster; the wind r7 x3 push 6; Halo friends r12 of the landing 20% 4 s; Horns +5 MP; never auto; MoveSkills off = the wind in place). MP steal at most 20 a cast. Guard: CombatService.DamagePlayer cuts a monster's hit only (GuardOf, the larger wins, the same extends, a real respawn clears; GuardPct / GuardUntil). Auto: X -> Z -> Q (Roar 3 within 16 or HP < 50% with one within 10; Field 2 inside the circle). MonsterService: Taunt (no boss / personal / someone else's live taunt, <= 10 s), Slow (boss half, strongest stays, <= 10 s, Pace), HopReach (zone, water, walls, ledges over 8, the Displace steps), DamageMonster castId (one hit a cast).
limitations: The client side (SkillFx circles / roar / hop movement, the HP bar shield, SkillBar X) is game dev 1's and image dev's; the hop's real character move, the monsters' real walk under Slow / Taunt (aiStep is checked statically) and the live AnalyticsService are not run offline. SK1 / SK2 and the SkillHit Slot filter are in tools/test_town_quests.py; the next-goal line in tools/test_onboarding.py.
